searchText: <@!543900561460822016> I don't know how, but the EIPV bot is broken again, in the same way as before (which you already fixed!): <https://travis-ci.org/github/ethereum/EIPs/jobs/731559071> I’m wondering if this is the issue where it runs against an old version. I don’t know why that would be the case though, it should just apply the diff to its HEAD. Will look into it more Unfortunately, it isn't clear to me why travis *isn't* testing the PR applied to master. Will continue looking, but i would recommend you manually rebase it. That should resolve the issue
